# Code Anchors: Sign-in Gate

- `src/app/SignInGate.tsx` — the gate: splash, redirect to Sign-in, or the page with its household
- `src/app/session.tsx` — session states, the household given to pages, and the saved return path
- `src/pages/SignInPage.tsx` — the Sign-in page, the "not in our household" state and the move to the return path
- `src/app/Splash.tsx` — the neutral splash shown while the session is restored
- `src/services/firebase.ts` — Google redirect sign-in, session restore and the membership read
- `src/services/types.ts` — the sign-in service the gate depends on
- `src/app/signIn.test.tsx` — tests the gate, the non-member state and the return path
- `.env.example` — names the auth domain setting, which is the app's own hosting domain
